summary: Optiver is corporation, founded in 1986. Type: private company. About 997 employees (Wikidata). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 7 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about acquisitions; 2 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: Amsterdam-founded trading and market-making firm; highly competitive English-language entry roles and internships, IND sponsor, with frequent visa mentions.

culture.text: All 7 jobs are in Amsterdam, mostly entry level and internships in software engineering, finance and data.
Staff often come from UNSW, Cambridge, Sydney, UvA and Imperial, studying computer science, mathematics and economics.
A global firm with offices in Amsterdam, Sydney, Chicago, Austin, Taipei, Hong Kong, Shanghai, London, New York and Singapore.

open.text: Optiver Holding B.V. and Optiver Services B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.
None of its 7 jobs here require Dutch and 57% mention visa or relocation.
Jobs draw about 200 applicants each on LinkedIn on average, so expect tough competition.

growth.text: Founded in 1986, now about 2,904 people on LinkedIn and a partner of 70+ exchanges.
Buying a majority stake in Dutch energy trader Northpool.
Expanding market making into autocallable ETFs.
Hired a Barclays managing director for a new exotics trading business.
